evidence_quotes.O: Truthfully, I bought this unit for the sheer 'gee whiz' factor.
evidence_quotes.C: For my test I used Dragon's Naturally Speaking software, a program notoriously fickle on what microphones it will accept.
evidence_quotes.E: Guess what? Whipped it out of the box, turned it on (w/o charging it) and it had a lock within 5 seconds, inside my house!
evidence_quotes.A: If you can't figure out how to operate this unit, it's because you can't read or find the power button.
evidence_quotes.N: Yes, I've used GPS systems before, but most of them were disappointments due to confusing user functions, inaccurate mapping, etc.
